zh:
> 译注：原文 Slack 社区入口本次检查返回 HTTP 403；可使用原文提供的 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues)联系项目。原链接保留。 # SGLang：面向大语言模型和多模态模型的快速推理

Docs | Cookbook | Website | Blog | Slack

SGLang 是面向大语言模型、视觉语言模型和扩散模型的开源推理框架，针对智能体工作负载、大规模服务和强化学习 rollout 进行了优化。[SGLang Diffusion](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/sglang-diffusion) 是其内置图像与视频生成引擎，包含在本仓库和 `sglang` Python 软件包中。 👋 可从下方开始使用，也可在 [SGLang Events](https://www.sglang.io/events) 与社区交流，包括线下聚会、开发者会议、工作坊和答疑时间。 > **[SGLang Summit 2026：与开放 AI 的构建者见面](https://www.sglang.io/summit)**
> **年度旗舰聚会 · 11 月 12–13 日 · 旧金山** > > 通过技术演讲、现场演示和实践工作坊深入了解推理、训练和 AI 硬件。带上你的部署难题，与构建相关技术栈的工程师和研究人员交流。 ## 开始使用 拉取包含 SGLang 及其依赖的 Docker 镜像： ```bash docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:latest ``` 也可以在已激活的 Python 环境中使用 uv 安装 SGLang： ```bash uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang ``` 接下来启动模型： - [快速入门](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/get-started/quickstart):运行第一个模型并发送请求。 - [Cookbook](https://cookbook.sglang.io/):选择模型和硬件，获取可直接运行的启动命令。 ## 支持的硬件 SGLang 支持多种 GPU、TPU、NPU、CPU 和 Apple Silicon 平台。 | 平台 | 代表性硬件 | | --- | --- | | [NVIDIA](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/nvidia-gpus) | B200/B300/GB200/GB300; H100/H200/H800/H20; A100; RTX 30/40/50 系列, RTX 6000 Ada / PRO 6000; DGX Spark, Jetson Orin | | [AMD](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/amd_gpu) | Instinct MI300X, MI325X, MI350X, MI355X | | [Google TPU](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/tpu) | v6e, v7; [SGLang-TorchTPU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu) / [SGL-JAX](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-jax) | | Intel ([GPU](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/xpu) / [CPU](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/cpu_server)) | Arc / Arc Pro B 系列 GPU、Xeon CPU | | [Apple Silicon](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/apple_metal) | 通过 Metal / MLX 使用 Mac | | [Huawei Ascend](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/getting-started/installation) | A2, A3, 950PR/DT NPUs | | [Moore Threads](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/mthreads_gpu) | MTT S5000 GPUs | 正在进行集成： AWS Trainium, [Alibaba T-Head PPU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/37519), [Cambricon MLU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/26898), Qualcomm QAIC, MetaX, Hygon HCU/DCU, Iluvatar CoreX 等。 SGLang-TorchTPU 通过 PyTorch、torch_tpu 和 Pallas 内核将 SGLang 服务引擎带到 Google TPU。它支持在 TPU7x（Ironwood）上提供大语言模型和视觉语言模型服务，包括跨主机张量并行和专家并行。SGL-JAX 提供基于 JAX 的 TPU 服务路径。 请参阅 [Cookbook](https://cookbook.sglang.io/)及各平台指南，了解模型兼容性和配置方式。 ## SGL 生态 | 领域 | 项目 | 用途 | | --- | --- | --- | | 扩散 | [SGLang Diffusion](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/sglang-diffusion/installation) | 内置于 SGLang，使用扩散模型生成图像和视频。 | | 音频 | [SGLang Omni](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni) | 用于文本转语音（TTS）和自动语音识别（ASR）的音频模型服务。 | | 推测解码 | [SpecForge](https://github.com/sgl-project/SpecForge) | 训练用于推测解码的草稿模型，并使用 SGLang 部署。 | | 强化学习与后训练 | [Miles](https://github.com/radixark/miles), [slime](https://github.com/THUDM/slime), [AReaL](https://github.com/inclusionAI/AReaL), [Tunix](https://github.com/google/tunix), [verl](https://github.com/volcengine/verl) | 集成 SGLang 以生成 rollout 的训练框架。 | | 部署与编排 | [SMG](https://github.com/smg-project/smg), [RBG](https://github.com/sgl-project/rbg), [llm-d](https://llm-d.ai/docs/dev/operations/disaggregation/sglang), [Ray Serve](https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/serve/llm/user-guides/sglang.html), [NVIDIA Dynamo](https://docs.nvidia.com/dynamo/backends/sg-lang/reference-guide) | 通过路由、负载均衡和集群编排部署与扩展 SGLang 推理服务。 | | 教育 | [Mini-SGLang](https://github.com/sgl-project/mini-sglang), [zero-to-sglang](https://github.com/datawhalechina/zero-to-sglang), [DeepLearning.AI course](https://www.deeplearning.ai/short-courses/efficient-inference-with-sglang-text-and-image-generation/) | 通过代码和实践课程学习推理引擎设计及高效文本、图像生成。 | ## 开发与贡献 欢迎贡献，包括错误修复、文档、模型支持和性能改进。 ### 开发环境配置 从 `lmsysorg/sglang:dev` Docker 镜像开始，该镜像提供开发工具和大部分依赖。在容器中克隆或挂载 SGLang 检出目录，然后从仓库根目录以可编辑模式安装，使测试使用本地 Python 修改： ```bash pip install -e "python" ``` 在已激活的虚拟环境中，也可以使用 `uv pip install --prerelease=allow -e "python"`。请参阅[开发指南](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/developer_guide/development_guide_using_docker)了解容器配置和测试方法。 ### 贡献 1. Fork 仓库并为修改创建分支。较大的更改请在 [GitHub issue](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues)或 [Slack](https://slack.sglang.io/)上讨论提议。 2. 完成修改、运行相关测试，并为修复或新行为添加回归覆盖。提交前运行 `pre-commit run --all-files`。 3. 创建 pull request，说明修改及测试方法；适用时附上基准测试或准确性评估。 格式、测试和 pull request 说明请参阅[贡献者指南](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/developer_guide/contribution_guide)。文档贡献者可以从[文档指南](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/62f9f3f785f889822ab4e78d65de9997d0b58441/docs/README.md)开始。 ## 社区与赞助 SGLang 由 [LMSYS](https://lmsys.org/about/) 托管，LMSYS 是一个非营利开源组织。 - **社区讨论：** 加入 [Slack](https://slack.sglang.io/)讨论技术问题和开发。 - **活动：** 在 [SGLang Events](https://www.sglang.io/events) 查找聚会、工作坊和答疑时间。 - **更新：** 关注 [X](https://x.com/lmsysorg)和 [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sgl-project/)了解项目更新，并通过 [LMSYS Blog](https://lmsys.org/blog/)查看版本公告和技术文章。 - **项目资源：** 查看[文档](https://docs.sglang.io/), [Cookbook](https://cookbook.sglang.io/), [路线图](https://roadmap.sglang.io/), [发行说明](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/releases), [问题跟踪器](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues),和[贡献者指南](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/developer_guide/contribution_guide). - **联系我们：** 有关企业采用和部署、技术咨询、赞助或合作，请联系 [sglang@lmsys.org](mailto:sglang@lmsys.org). - **贡献者赞助：** 长期活跃的 SGLang 贡献者有资格获得编码智能体赞助，包括 Cursor、Claude Code 或 OpenAI Codex。申请时请发送邮件至 [sglang@lmsys.org](mailto:sglang@lmsys.org)，并附上关键提交或 pull request 的链接。 ## 受到工业界与研究界信赖 项目称 SGLang 为 AI 实验室、云平台、企业和大学的生产工作负载提供服务。 ## 致谢 我们借鉴了以下项目的设计并复用了其代码： [Guidance](https://github.com/guidance-ai/guidance), [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm), [LightLLM](https://github.com/ModelTC/lightllm), [FlashInfer](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer), [Outlines](https://github.com/outlines-dev/outlines)，以及 [LMQL](https://github.com/eth-sri/lmql).
en:
# SGLang: Fast inference for LLMs and multimodal models

Docs | Cookbook | Website | Blog | Slack

SGLang is an open-source inference framework for large language, vision-language, and diffusion models, optimized for agentic workloads, large-scale serving, and RL rollouts. [SGLang Diffusion](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/sglang-diffusion) is its built-in image and video generation engine, included in this repository and the `sglang` Python package. 👋 Get started below, or meet the community at [SGLang Events](https://www.sglang.io/events), including meetups, developer meetings, workshops, and office hours. > **[SGLang Summit 2026: Meet the builders of open AI](https://www.sglang.io/summit)**
> **Our flagship annual gathering · November 12–13 · San Francisco** > > Go deep on inference, training, and AI hardware through technical talks, live demos, and hands-on workshops. Bring your deployment challenges and meet the engineers and researchers building the stack. ## Get Started Pull the Docker image, which includes SGLang and its dependencies: ```bash docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:latest ``` Alternatively, install SGLang in an activated Python environment with uv: ```bash uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang ``` Next, launch your model: - [Quickstart](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/get-started/quickstart): Run your first model and send a request. - [Cookbook](https://cookbook.sglang.io/): Choose your model and hardware to get a ready-to-run launch command. ## Supported Hardware SGLang supports a wide range of GPUs, TPUs, NPUs, CPUs, and Apple Silicon platforms. | Platform | Representative hardware | | --- | --- | | [NVIDIA](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/nvidia-gpus) | B200/B300/GB200/GB300; H100/H200/H800/H20; A100; RTX 30/40/50 series, RTX 6000 Ada / PRO 6000; DGX Spark, Jetson Orin | | [AMD](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/amd_gpu) | Instinct MI300X, MI325X, MI350X, MI355X | | [Google TPU](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/tpu) | v6e, v7; [SGLang-TorchTPU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu) / [SGL-JAX](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-jax) | | Intel ([GPU](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/xpu) / [CPU](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/cpu_server)) | Arc / Arc Pro B-Series GPUs, Xeon CPUs | | [Apple Silicon](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/apple_metal) | Macs via Metal / MLX | | [Huawei Ascend](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/ascend-npus/getting-started/installation) | A2, A3, 950PR/DT NPUs | | [Moore Threads](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/hardware-platforms/mthreads_gpu) | MTT S5000 GPUs | Integrations in progress: AWS Trainium, [Alibaba T-Head PPU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/37519), [Cambricon MLU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/26898), Qualcomm QAIC, MetaX, Hygon HCU/DCU, Iluvatar CoreX, and more. SGLang-TorchTPU brings the SGLang serving engine to Google TPUs through PyTorch, torch_tpu, and Pallas kernels. It supports LLM and vision-language serving on TPU7x (Ironwood), including tensor and expert parallelism across hosts. SGL-JAX provides the JAX-based TPU serving path. See the [Cookbook](https://cookbook.sglang.io/) and platform guides for model compatibility and setup. ## SGL Ecosystem | Area | Projects | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | Diffusion | [SGLang Diffusion](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/sglang-diffusion/installation) | Built into SGLang for image and video generation with diffusion models. | | Audio | [SGLang Omni](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni) | Audio model serving for text-to-speech (TTS) and automatic speech recognition (ASR). | | Speculative Decoding | [SpecForge](https://github.com/sgl-project/SpecForge) | Train draft models for speculative decoding and deploy them with SGLang. | | RL and Post-Training | [Miles](https://github.com/radixark/miles), [slime](https://github.com/THUDM/slime), [AReaL](https://github.com/inclusionAI/AReaL), [Tunix](https://github.com/google/tunix), [verl](https://github.com/volcengine/verl) | Training frameworks that integrate SGLang for rollout generation. | | Deployment and Orchestration | [SMG](https://github.com/smg-project/smg), [RBG](https://github.com/sgl-project/rbg), [llm-d](https://llm-d.ai/docs/dev/operations/disaggregation/sglang), [Ray Serve](https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/serve/llm/user-guides/sglang.html), [NVIDIA Dynamo](https://docs.nvidia.com/dynamo/backends/sg-lang/reference-guide) | Deploy and scale SGLang inference services with routing, load balancing, and cluster orchestration. | | Education | [Mini-SGLang](https://github.com/sgl-project/mini-sglang), [zero-to-sglang](https://github.com/datawhalechina/zero-to-sglang), [DeepLearning.AI course](https://www.deeplearning.ai/short-courses/efficient-inference-with-sglang-text-and-image-generation/) | Learn inference engine design and efficient text and image generation through code and hands-on courses. | ## Development and Contributing Contributions are welcome, from bug fixes and documentation to model support and performance improvements. ### Development setup Start from the `lmsysorg/sglang:dev` Docker image, which provides development tools and most dependencies. Clone or mount your SGLang checkout inside the container, then install it in editable mode from the repository root so tests use your local Python changes: ```bash pip install -e "python" ``` In an activated virtual environment, you can use `uv pip install --prerelease=allow -e "python"` instead. See the [development guide](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/developer_guide/development_guide_using_docker) for container setup and testing. ### Contribute 1. Fork the repository and create a branch for your changes. For larger changes, discuss your proposal in a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues) or on [Slack](https://slack.sglang.io/). 2. Make your changes, run the relevant tests, and add regression coverage for fixes or new behavior. Run `pre-commit run --all-files` before submitting. 3. Open a pull request describing the change and how you tested it. Include benchmarks or accuracy evaluations when relevant. See the [contributor guide](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/developer_guide/contribution_guide) for formatting, testing, and pull request instructions. Documentation contributors can start with the [docs guide](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/62f9f3f785f889822ab4e78d65de9997d0b58441/docs/README.md). ## Community and Sponsorship SGLang is hosted by [LMSYS](https://lmsys.org/about/), a non-profit open-source organization. - **Community discussions:** Join [Slack](https://slack.sglang.io/) for technical questions and development discussions. - **Events:** Find meetups, workshops, and office hours on [SGLang Events](https://www.sglang.io/events). - **Updates:** Follow [X](https://x.com/lmsysorg) and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sgl-project/) for project updates, and the [LMSYS Blog](https://lmsys.org/blog/) for release announcements and technical articles. - **Project resources:** Explore the [documentation](https://docs.sglang.io/), [Cookbook](https://cookbook.sglang.io/), [roadmap](https://roadmap.sglang.io/), [release notes](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/releases), [issue tracker](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues), and [contributor guide](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/developer_guide/contribution_guide). - **Contact Us:** For enterprise adoption and deployment, technical consulting, sponsorship, or partnership inquiries, please contact [sglang@lmsys.org](mailto:sglang@lmsys.org). - **Contributor sponsorship:** Long-term active SGLang contributors are eligible for coding agent sponsorship, including Cursor, Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex. To apply, email [sglang@lmsys.org](mailto:sglang@lmsys.org) with links to your key commits or pull requests. ## Trusted by Industry and Research SGLang serves production workloads across AI labs, cloud platforms, enterprises, and universities. ## Acknowledgment We learned the design and reused code from the following projects: [Guidance](https://github.com/guidance-ai/guidance), [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm), [LightLLM](https://github.com/ModelTC/lightllm), [FlashInfer](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer), [Outlines](https://github.com/outlines-dev/outlines), and [LMQL](https://github.com/eth-sri/lmql).
